bcg-59461.text: We are expanding our team: As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you will contribute to the development and deployment of innovative AI solutions, collaborating with clients across diverse industries. Ideal candidates bring strong software development expertise and a passion for large-scale data analytics.

bcg-59702.text: We are expanding our team: As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer Intern, you will contribute to the development of innovative AI solutions, collaborating with clients and internal teams. Ideal for students pursuing a Master's or PhD with a passion for software development and large-scale data analytics.

bcg-56622.text: We are recruiting a Senior AI Tech Architect to lead the development of innovative IT solutions for the US Public Sector. Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to design and optimize technology architectures, applying deep expertise in IT architecture and solution design. Ideal for experienced professionals with a strong background in software engineering and architecture.

bcg-57014.text: Join our team as a Senior AI Tech Architect - AI Platforms, where you will design and implement intelligent, agentic AI platforms and collaborate with engineers and data scientists. This role is ideal for experienced professionals with a strong background in software engineering and AI development, seeking to contribute to innovative digital solutions.

bcg-58119.text: Exciting opportunity for a cybersecurity expert to drive innovative solutions and lead cybersecurity transformation at BCG Platinion. Oversee cybersecurity strategy, implement security programs, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Ideal for experienced professionals with a strong background in cybersecurity consulting or management.

bcg-59541.text: Join us as a Senior AI Tech Consultant, Cybersecurity, where you will lead end-to-end cybersecurity and digital risk solutions for clients. Drive innovative strategies, implement advanced cybersecurity frameworks, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. Ideal for experienced cybersecurity professionals with strong technical and consulting expertise.

bcg-60224.text: We are seeking a Delivery AI Product Analyst to drive product strategy and delivery for BCG’s new business unit. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance product capabilities and support commercialization of AI-driven solutions. Ideal for candidates with experience in product management, AI tools, and stakeholder engagement.

bcg-58332.text: We are looking for a Delivery AI Product Analyst to deliver and support BCG's retail apps and agents, focusing on Merch AI. You will coordinate deployments, gather client requirements, and advise on best practices. Ideal candidates have strong tech expertise, experience in B2B app deployment, and a keen interest in AI and data science.
